name: patent-ru
title_zh: 俄专利检索与 FIPS 申请文件撰写一条龙
tagline_zh: 做俄罗斯市场的硬件团队最怕两件事：查不到苏联时期的老专利，和写出的申请被 FIPS 以格式问题退回。
tagline_en: For teams filing in Russia: it queries the Rospatent search API including the Soviet fund, then drafts and edits.
desc_en: Russian patent prosecution and prior-art search skill — combines Rospatent (ИС ПП) database search, including the Soviet/Russian fund via the official search-platform API, with drafting and editing of application documents under FIPS requirements (order of the Russian Ministry of Economic Development No. 107, 21.02.2023). Use when the user mentions патентный поиск, поиск аналогов, база Роспатента,
why_zh: 检索走官方平台 API 而不是网页抓取，苏联时期的老文献也在同一批结果里。
why_en: Search goes through the official platform API rather than scraping, so Soviet-era filings surface in the same result set.
limit_zh: 只覆盖俄罗斯联邦境内程序：Rospatent 检索、FIPS 格式的申请文件起草与修改。不碰欧亚专利。
limit_en: Covers Russian Federation procedure only: Rospatent search and FIPS-format drafting/editing. No EAPO, PCT international phase, US/EP practice, fee.
title_en: Russian patent search and FIPS filing drafter
